frame: +X left, +Y up, +Z forward; meters (scaled); origin on the ground midway between the hips
placement: item display at the mech origin; matrix = mech * segment(pose) * translate(pivot) * rotate_xyz(rest). aim parts instead sit at their posed pivot with local +Y turned toward their posed links.to point. The pack scales the half-size models back to 1:1.

anims.aim: at its pivot on its segment, local +Y aimed at links.to on links.to_segment (pistons)
anims.spin_z: rigid with its segment, then turned about its own local Z (heavy gun barrels)
anims.hinge_x: rigid with its segment, then turned about its own local X at its pivot (the roof hatch, hinged at its front edge; positive opens it)
anims.extend_y: rigid with its segment, then scaled along its own local Y from its pivot by the deploy fraction (the boarding ladder's drop section, hanging down from its top)

damage_state: custom_model_data string 0 = "damaged" swaps to the _damaged model
